text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaahーー!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: (What a rush...! The heat—their feelings are piercing right through my skin...!)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Seize a rock-solid victory—
and become the cornerstone that nurtures the future!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Mother's regrets...!
I will clear them away with victory—and prove myself!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—I have to pass it on!
That brilliance I yearned for...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: With these legs of mine!! I'm gonna etch it into the future...!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(—My heart... is trembling!
Basking head-on in this fiery passion...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: (It's so fun...—)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The heat is unbelievable!!
A clash of heroines in this year's Triple Tiara, and the first to claim a crown is—!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Ghh!
Ah... this hurts so much...!!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't become... the Queen.
...Yetâ

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, geez!
That was so much fun!
choice_data_list: (Heart... has a great look on her face.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Now then—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Great job today,
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Heart-san...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Even if it didn't lead to results this time... my spirit hasn't broken.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
The title of Queen of the Oaks rightfully belongs to me!
Next time—I shall prove it!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Craft!
That's not all the strength you've got, is it?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!!
...But next time—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
Craft—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Even in defeat, you never lose your confidence, huh?
...That's just like you, Heart.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"I must object, Heart-san.
The Queen of the Oaks is...—"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "The steadfastness of the Oaks is something I, of all people, must grasp."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe.
Looks like the next one's gonna be just as heated.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Our path is still—
just beginning right now.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "A race like today's... we'll definitely make it happen, all of us together!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh...! They're all bumping fists!
Man... this feels just like peak youth...

For Daring Heart, who sought fiery races where souls clashed against one another—
it seemed she had met the greatest rivals possible.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
“—The next race where everyone can compete together is...
the 'Oaks', isn't it.”

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Wow!
I knew it, you feel it too, don't you...?!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "I'm still flushed too! Those two minutes—not even two minutes... I keep replaying them over and over."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Everyone was truly... incredible! Especially you, Craft.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Her speed, her feelings...
They're what fire me up the most."
choice_data_list: And what is she to you...?
And what is she to you...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes, no matter what... it's special.
I want to race you again and again...!
choice_data_list: (I want to see it too... over and over again!)
(I want to see it... as many times as it takes, too!)

text_block_list.text:
"I thought I'd get to see another heated race.
However――"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I won't run in the 'Oaks'—
I'm running in the 'NHK Mile Cup'!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Trainer, that just now...!
It was shocking news. The NHK Mile Cup was a mile race limited to Classic-class Umamusume...
If Rhein Kraft judged that she is better suited for shorter distances, then it makes sense that she avoided the 2,400m 'Yushun Himba (Oaks)'.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Craft isn't...
coming to the 'Oaks'?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah, Heart-san...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe, you're late!
I was just talking to Cesario and the others until just now!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"You've already made up your mind, haven't you?
...That determination of yours won't waver."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Still, why?
After all that..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: You told me you loved the Triple Tiara so much... That it was your dream, didn't you—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
“—It's my dream!
Even now... and forever...!!”

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I had to make up my mind.
Even if the distance was too long for me...
Whether to see my dream through to the end.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: In the place where I can shine the brightest—I'll carve out a brand-new possibility for the Tiara...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...!
A new... possibility...?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Heart-san, you know it too, right?
Any Tiara Umamusume who went from
the Oka Sho to the NHK Mile Cup—"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: That there's not a single soul left!
choice_data_list: ! So what you're aiming for is——
! So what you're aiming for is——

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
“—The first irregular rotation in history.
Winning the NHK Mile Cup
right after the Oka Sho...!”

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
I know I can do it...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
From here on, we can show a brand-new dream
to the girls who are captivated
by the radiance of the Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Just like how I looked up to the challenges taken on by the Tiara Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Craft...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...I struggled with it.
I thought about it so, so much...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
But you know... I thought it was wonderful,
and my heart... was truly moved.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm heading back to the dorms.
What about you?"
choice_data_list: ...I'll wrap up the rest of the work.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I see.
...Well then, see you tomorrow."
choice_data_list: —I plan on staying out late tonight, so...

text_block_list.name: Smartphone Voice
text_block_list.text:
"—Mejiro Ramonu!
Unstoppable! She crosses the line in first!
She captures the second crown of the Triple Tiara!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "...I wonder just how many times I've watched this race over again."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(The Triple Tiara...
I longed for it. It was my dream.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(That is the sole reason――
I came all the way to this land, all by myself...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(...There's no way I could forget.
Not my days at Hiruesta Academy, nor the days of hard work chasing my dream.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I will become the Queen.
The dream I embraced that day...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...And yet.
Why?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Haa... hah...!
Haaaaaaaaaaaaargh!!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Why...—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer?
May I come in?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Can I rest for a bit?
Right by your side.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "—This room spray has a wonderful woody scent, doesn't it...?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Craft said so, didn't she?
That her heart was deeply moved.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
What truly moved my heart
were the races of the Triple Tiara.
I can say that with certainty.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Still, I wonder why...
What comes to mind is—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Nothing but races with Craft.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: From the Hanshin JF, to the Fillies' Revue, and the Oka Sho... I've been running alongside that girl the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Every single bit of it is vividly etched into my heart.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...My dream of the Queen, and my youth with that girl.
Both are very—precious to me.

Daring Heart is currently torn between sticking
to the original plan or chasing after Rhein Kraft...

However, in all likelihood, she has already—
made up her mind.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
choice_data_list: You too... you "couldn't help but move" either, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...You really see
right through me, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
“Still... are you fine with that?
Everything we've planned so far will change.”
choice_data_list: I can handle something like that easily enough.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Heheh.
...Look at you, all dependable now.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Phew......

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...I've decided.
My mind is made up. I will choose—youth."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Our next race will be—the NHK Mile Cup.
Let us press forward... following this heart of mine."
